Lina (AE): Heads up — AcmeHealth POC can't provision their Dedicated reservation. Request: 4x A100 in us-central1-a, strict(single-AZ) affinity. Job id prow-7789. Customer is asking if we can keep single-AZ for latency/compliance and wants a committed price quote. Also attached a security questionnaire (HIPAA + SOC2). Anyone available to triage?
Ethan (SE): On it. Can you paste the exact allocator error from the job or the scheduler log? Also is this a brand-new reservation or a resize of an existing pool?
Lina (AE): New reservation. I retried twice, same failure. Error shown in console: "strict_affinity_unavailable". They want single-AZ because of an internal rule, but said might accept a written mitigation.
Riya (Infra): Pulling logs. Relevant allocator snippet below:
```
[allocator] ERROR ReservationConflict: strict_affinity_unavailable
 requested_zones=[us-central1-a]
 available_pools={us-central1-a:0, us-central1-b:2, us-central1-c:4}
 quota_remaining=4
 suggestion: try_preference_only or split_across_zones
```
So us-central1-a has zero spare capacity for that GPU type right now. We have 6 total available in region but not concentrated in 'a'.
Ethan (SE): For pricing: committed per-GPU-month applies regardless of AZ topology — we don't add a multi-AZ surcharge. The main difference is operational: cross-AZ split can add 3-15ms tail latency and slightly higher failure surface. We can include a SLA note. 
Nina (CS): On the security questionnaire: Dedicated supports VPC peering + customer-managed KMS + audit logs and can meet HIPAA needs with BAAs via legal. We'll need to route their security contact to our compliance team for the formal attestation.
Lina (AE): Customer is pushing back on multi-AZ. They asked if we can guarantee placement in a single AZ if we keep the request smaller (e.g., 2 GPUs) or commit earlier. Is that possible?
Riya (Infra): Two levers: 1) Reduce reservation_count to 2 — allocator can likely place 2 in us-central1-a immediately. 2) If they need 4 in single AZ, we can offer to queue a capacity claim with the cloud provider for 72h lead time (not instantaneous) — not guaranteed but increases chance. Also we can attempt preference_only provisioning which is best-effort: will put as many as possible in a and the rest elsewhere. Example command we used: `start_reservation prow-7789 --mode=preference_only --fallback=us-central1-b`
alloc-bot: provisioning_task queued (attempt=1)
Ethan (SE): If they accept preference_only, we can add a mitigation statement explaining latency expectations + run a short perf test during the POC to measure cross-AZ impact. For compliance, we can provide an audit trail showing which AZs the GPUs were actually provisioned in.
Lina (AE): I'm drafting an email offering two options: A) shrink to 2x A100 in us-central1-a (immediate), B) keep 4x but accept preference_only with failover to b, plus a signed note on latency variance and audit access. Which do you prefer to propose as default?
Nina (CS): Offer B as default (less friction for their workload), and call out option A as a fast shortcut. We'll also request their security lead for the compliance packet handoff.
Riya (Infra): I kicked preference_only reprovision. alloc-bot: attempt=2 -> AllocationPartial alloc-9001 placed 2@us-central1-a,1@us-central1-b,1@us-central1-c status=PARTIAL_PREFERRED
alloc-bot: AllocationComplete alloc-9001
Ethan (SE): I'll prepare the quote: committed price for 4 GPUs at customer tier, include a note that committed billing applies to all 4 regardless of AZ split, and add a 30-day review to allow them to request changes. Lina, can you confirm they want the committed invoice now?
Lina (AE): Customer replied: "We need committed pricing now. We'll accept preference placement for POC but require proof of data separation and audit logs for first 72h. Also want to confirm KMS key possession."
Nina (CS): We can provide read-only audit access for 72h and a signed statement that keys are customer-managed KMS. I'll start the signed grant for audit access and loop in Security for KMS confirmation.
Ethan (SE): Confirmed: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; we can include the key policy template. Also I'll add a 1-paragraph note explaining expected 3-12ms variance when GPUs are cross-AZ within us-central1 for model inference traffic.
Lina (AE): All set — customer accepted preference_only for the POC and requested the committed quote + security pack. Nina, Riya, Ethan thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll upload the SOW and pricing PDF once you confirm the audit grant.
Nina (CS): Audit access grant created for AcmeHealth principals for 72h. Grant id=grant-2202. Sent to Lina to deliver.
Riya (Infra): final note: if they ever need strict single-AZ 4x guarantee we'll suggest reserved lead time or switching regions where capacity is available. For now alloc-9001 is live.
Lina (AE): Marking this POC as unblocked. Great team work. :party:
